title: The cocone $E_X\to\overline{\mathbf Q}_{\ell,X}$
statement:
Let $\ell$ be a prime, fix an algebraic closure $\Qlb$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$, and let $X$ be a scheme. Let $I$ be the poset of finite intermediate fields $\mathbf Q_\ell\subseteq E\subseteq\Qlb$ ([sk-def-sfb-qlbar-condensed]), regarded as a category with one arrow $E\to F$ exactly when $E\subseteq F$. Write $p_X^*$ for the functor of [sk-def-sfb-pullback-from-point].

Define $D_X:I\to\Sh(X_{\mathrm{proét}},\Ab)$ by $D_X(E)=E_X=p_X^*\underline E$ ([def-sfb-subfield-coefficient-ring]) and $D_X(E\subseteq F)=p_X^*\iota_{E,F}$, where $\iota_{E,F}:\underline E\to\underline F$ is [def-sfb-qlbar-subextension-map].

The cocone in this definition has vertex $\overline{\mathbf Q}_{\ell,X}=p_X^*\underline{\Qlb}$ ([def-sfb-qlbar-coefficient-ring]) and leg $p_X^*j_E:E_X\to\overline{\mathbf Q}_{\ell,X}$ at $E$, where $j_E:\underline E\to\underline{\Qlb}$ is [def-sfb-qlbar-subextension-to-qlbar]. Equivalently it is the image under $p_X^*$ of the cocone with vertex $\underline{\Qlb}$ and legs $j_E$ over the diagram $E\mapsto\underline E$, $E\subseteq F\mapsto\iota_{E,F}$.

proof.text: Use the finite-subextension poset $I$ of [sk-def-sfb-qlbar-condensed]. The transition maps of [def-sfb-qlbar-subextension-map] satisfy $\iota_{E,E}=\mathrm{id}$ and $\iota_{F,H}\circ\iota_{E,F}=\iota_{E,H}$. Since $p_X^*$ of [sk-def-sfb-pullback-from-point] is a functor, $p_X^*(\mathrm{id})=\mathrm{id}$ and $p_X^*(\iota_{F,H})\circ p_X^*(\iota_{E,F})=p_X^*(\iota_{E,H})$. These are precisely the identity and composition conditions for $D_X$ with object $E_X$ of [def-sfb-subfield-coefficient-ring].

source.place: The diagram is p_X^* applied to the diagram E ↦ underline E; functors send cocones to cocones.

proof.text: The statement of [def-sfb-qlbar-subextension-to-qlbar] gives $j_F\circ\iota_{E,F}=j_E$. Apply the functor $p_X^*$ of [sk-def-sfb-pullback-from-point] to this equality: $p_X^*j_F\circ p_X^*\iota_{E,F}=p_X^*j_E$. Thus the displayed legs satisfy exactly the cocone condition. Their domains are $E_X$ by [def-sfb-subfield-coefficient-ring] and their common codomain is $\overline{\mathbf Q}_{\ell,X}$ by [def-sfb-qlbar-coefficient-ring]. Applying a functor to a cocone means applying it to its vertex and each leg, so this is also the asserted image cocone.
